title: Select Sector indices — conditional quarter-end secondary reweighting (24%/4.8%/50% breach test)
source: EST: rule-derived, not a scheduled publication. SEC EDGAR, Select Sector SPDR Trust Form 497 filed 2026-01-31 (fetched direct 2026-09-04): 'if, on the second to last business day of March, June, September, or December a company has a weight greater than 24% or the sum of the companies with weights greater than 4.8% exceeds 50%, a secondary reweighting will be triggered with the reweighting effective date being after the close of the last business day of the month.' September 2026's last business day is Wed 09-30 and the second-to-last is Tue 09-29, so the test is 09-29 and the trade, IF triggered, clears at the 09-30 close. Filed estimate because the trigger is CONDITIONAL — most quarters it does not fire, and no primary source can pre-confirm that it will
notes: A CONDITIONAL BACKSTOP, not a base case — the one other dated afternoon this quarter where a forced index trade can appear with no announcement to warn of it. Discovered during sp-rebalance-proforma-capped-2026-09-11 initial research (2026-09-04) off stale vendor ETF pages; RE-MEASURED 2026-09-16 (D-14) from SSGA's own daily-holdings share counts x Yahoo closes across all eleven Select Sector SPDRs, which reproduces published weights to +/-0.005pp on XLK/XLC. With the 2026-09-11 quarterly reference close struck, the 09-18 cap is computable rather than guessed: only XLE (over-4.8% group 58.37% -> 45.7%) and XLY (AMZN 24.94% -> 23.00%) are capped. XLC is NOT capped (group 47.44%, under the 50% trigger), so it enters the 09-29 test with no reset, at 48.06% on 09-15 — 1.94pp out, one marginal name (DIS 4.68%, +2.6% relative) from a ~4.6pp discontinuous step. That inverts the 09-04 placement, which called XLC least likely and XLY/AMZN the live leg; replaying 5y of 10-session return vectors onto current baskets puts XLC in breach in 47.6% of windows vs 7.0% for AMZN and <=0.9% for every other fund. The rule's 4.5% floor on capped group members preserves the same knife-edge the 2024-09-23 methodology change was credited with removing. Sizing likewise rose: a fired XLC reweighting is a median ~7.5pp ~= $1.73B one-way in META/GOOGL/GOOG, not the ~$300M first banked. Status stays `estimate` and impact stays `low` because the TRIGGER is conditional and unobservable until after the 09-30 close, not because the date is doubtful: 24%/23% and 4.8%/4.5% are trigger/target pairs (SEC-filed primary), and the test date is the second-to-last business day of the quarter, Tue 2026-09-29. No house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4/G1) is index-flow-keyed; this entry widens caution about the 09-29/09-30 closes and licenses nothing. Kind `sector` remains the closest fit the enum offers for a market-structure flow event; the imperfect fit is named, not fixed from this lane.
